description: This file defines extension methods for configuring ADO.NET streaming within an Orleans silo using a builder pattern. It provides methods to add ADO.NET persistent streams to the silo configuration, supporting options customization.

classes.name: SiloBuilderAdoNetStreamExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure ADO.NET streams in an Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams (overload 1)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use ADO.NET persistent streams with custom options provided via a configureOptions action.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams (overload 2)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use ADO.NET persistent streams with a provided configurator delegate.
